## Mathematical Markdown

- Unslop ignores LaTeX math delimited by `\(...\)`, `\[...\]`, `$...$`, and `$$...$$`. Function arguments inside equations no longer count as prose asides.
- Equation references such as `(12)` and `(CW5)` no longer count as parenthetical asides.
- Added CLI fixtures covering math, surrounding prose, Unicode source locations, currency, escaped delimiters, comments, code, and unclosed expressions.
- Updated the copyable configuration to release 1.23.
